If dwTimeout is set to zero, the function tests the state of the specified event objects and returns immediately. If dwTimeout is set to WSA_INFINITE, the timeout interval never expires.
parameters.name: dwTimeout

parameters.description: Indicator specifying whether the function returns when the system queues an I/O completion routine for execution by the calling thread. If TRUE, the completion routine is executed and the function returns. If FALSE, the completion routine is not executed when the function returns.
parameters.name: fAlertable
